text:
Noah: Post-webinar routing thread  we need to lock down lead SLA and who owns follow-ups. Quick asks: 1) which leads get immediate SDR outreach, 2) timeline for asset posting, 3) who hands off the high-intent list.
Priya: Immediate plan: post deck + transcript within 5m of recording, upload full video within 30m. I'll post links in chat and Slack channel.
Sam: For lead tagging: auto-tag registrants who asked a Q as 'hot', attendees who clicked CTA as 'warm'. Send 'hot' leads to SDR within 1 hour, 'warm' within 24h. Agree?
Marta: Yes. Also add 'demo-request' tag for anyone who clicked the demo button. That one gets an automated calendar invite attempt from ops.
Ethan: Social: I'll extract 3 quote cards and a 60s demo clip. Need timestamps from the recording; Priya can provide once uploaded.
Jia: Infra note: we'll export attendee Q&A metadata in the event webhook. I'll add a field `asked_question:true` so Zap can tag them.
Noah: SDR routing: map 'hot' -> sdr-inbound@redwood.com, 'demo-request' -> demo-sales@redwood.com. SLA: initial outreach within 60m for hot, 8 business hours for demo-request.
Priya: I'll build the Zap: if Q&A flag true or CTA click, add tag and push to HubSpot with mapping. Will add a Slack confirmation message once it runs.
Sam: Ops-bot: please run post-event checks: confirm deck up, transcript up, video queueing started, and post a one-line status to #marketing-postmortem.
ops-bot: Acknowledged. Will ping channel when uploads complete.
Marta: Hand-off: Priya posts assets and the exported lead CSV to /sales/inbound/ for SDRs. Noah will own the handoff and confirm when outreach seeds are dispatched.
Ethan: Also prepare a short nurture email for 'warm' leads, scheduled at T+24h. I'll draft copy and share in drive.
Noah: Sounds good. Quick contingency: if video upload delayed >45m, Priya, please still post the transcript + deck and a short clip. SDR outreach should not wait on full video.
Priya: Agreed. I'll post deck+transcript immediately and mark video as pending.
Marta: Final: confirm SLAs in the postmortem doc and add expected follow-up cadence (hot: 3 touches in 7 days, warm: 2 touches in 14 days). I'll add those to the doc now.
Noah: Confirmed. Closing thread  will relay to SDRs after assets are up.
